audit.why: 40.94% over 127 games — the worst number in this slice, and the entry correctly concedes everything except the level 2-3 window. No stage needed moving.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1] and phases[3] key levels 2 and 4-5 to Sanguine Pool, which he cannot have at level 2. phases[4].why writes 'Between the Worlds'.
audit.why: He puts a point in Sanguine Pool at 2 at the earliest and usually later; at level 2 the ability that decides trades is Transfusion (Q, 9s at rank 1 falling to 4.6s). The real reason to name Sanguine Pool is its cooldown: 28 SECONDS at rank 1, dropping to 16s. That is the longest punish window in his kit and the entry never gives the number anywhere.
audit.corrected: phases[1] re-keyed to Transfusion, phases[3] now carries the 28s, ultimate name fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says Tides of Blood can be blocked by units, and nothing gives Sanguine Pool's real cooldown or duration.
audit.why: Tides of Blood (E, 13s at rank 1 down to 5s, 600 range) is blocked by enemy units — standing behind your own minions blanks the ability the entry calls the thing that zones you off the wave. Sanguine Pool is 2 seconds of untargetability on 28s at rank 1, which is the exact length of the bait window: poke him into pooling and you own the next 28 seconds. Hemoplague is a flat 120s and heals him for every champion it catches, so it is worse in a teamfight than in the 1v1.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt on the 28s pool and the minion-block rule.
